/************************************************************************
 * VarBoolFromR8 (OLEAUT32.122)
 *
 * Convert a VT_R8 to a VT_BOOL.
 *
 * PARAMS
 *  dblIn    [I] Source
 *  pBoolOut [O] Destination
 *
 * RETURNS
 *  S_OK.
 */
